description: This file manages temporary object directories (tmp_objdir) in a Git-like system, including creation, deletion, environment setup, migration of packfiles, and replacing primary object database sources.

classes.name: tmp_objdir
classes.description: Structure representing a temporary object directory in the system, containing references to the repository, path, environment variables, previous source, and a flag indicating if it will be destroyed.

methods.name: void tmp_objdir_free(struct tmp_objdir * t)
methods.description: Frees the memory associated with a tmp_objdir, releasing string buffers and clearing vectors.

methods.name: int tmp_objdir_destroy(struct tmp_objdir * t)
methods.description: Destroys a tmp_objdir, restoring previous sources if necessary and removing the directory recursively.

methods.name: void remove_tmp_objdir(void)
methods.description: Callback function used at exit to remove the temporary object directory.

methods.name: void tmp_objdir_discard_objects(struct tmp_objdir * t)
methods.description: Removes the directory contents but keeps the top-level directory.

methods.name: void env_append(struct strvec * env,const char * key,const char * val)
methods.description: Appends a value to an environment variable in a way that is compatible with older parsers.

methods.name: void env_replace(struct strvec * env,const char * key,const char * val)
methods.description: Overrides (sets) an environment variable to a specific value.

methods.name: int setup_tmp_objdir(const char * root)
methods.description: Creates a 'pack' directory inside the given root path.

methods.name: struct:tmp_objdir * tmp_objdir_create(struct repository * r,const char * prefix)
methods.description: Creates a new temporary object directory, sets up environment variables, and registers cleanup handlers.

methods.name: int pack_copy_priority(const char * name)
methods.description: Determines priority for copying pack files based on filename extensions.

methods.name: int pack_copy_cmp(const char * a,const char * b)
methods.description: Comparison function for sorting pack files based on their copy priority.

methods.name: int read_dir_paths(struct string_list * out,const char * path)
methods.description: Reads directory entries in a given path, excluding hidden files.

methods.name: int migrate_paths(struct tmp_objdir * t,struct strbuf * src,struct strbuf * dst,enum finalize_object_file_flags flags)
methods.description: Recursively migrates directory trees from source to destination, applying appropriate file handling.

methods.name: int migrate_one(struct tmp_objdir * t,struct strbuf * src,struct strbuf * dst,enum finalize_object_file_flags flags)
methods.description: Migrates a single file or directory, returning success or failure.

methods.name: int is_loose_object_shard(const char * name)
methods.description: Checks if a filename corresponds to a loose object shard (two hex digits).

methods.name: int tmp_objdir_migrate(struct tmp_objdir * t)
methods.description: Migrates the contents of the temporary object directory to the main repository directory.

methods.name: const char ** tmp_objdir_env(const struct tmp_objdir * t)
methods.description: Returns environment variables for the tmp_objdir.

methods.name: void tmp_objdir_add_as_alternate(const struct tmp_objdir * t)
methods.description: Adds the tmp_objdir as an alternate object database.

methods.name: void tmp_objdir_replace_primary_odb(struct tmp_objdir * t,int will_destroy)
methods.description: Replaces the primary object database with the tmp_objdir, optionally marking it for destruction.

methods.name: struct:tmp_objdir * tmp_objdir_unapply_primary_odb(void)
methods.description: Restores the original primary object database if it was replaced.

methods.name: void tmp_objdir_reapply_primary_odb(struct tmp_objdir * t,const char * old_cwd,const char * new_cwd)
methods.description: Reapplies a previously un-applied primary object database, updating its path.

ctags.name: env_append
ctags.pattern: /^static void env_append(struct strvec *env, const char *key, const char *val)$/
ctags.signature: (struct strvec * env,const char * key,const char * val)

ctags.name: env_replace
ctags.pattern: /^static void env_replace(struct strvec *env, const char *key, const char *val)$/
ctags.signature: (struct strvec * env,const char * key,const char * val)

ctags.signature: (struct tmp_objdir * t,struct strbuf * src,struct strbuf * dst,enum finalize_object_file_flags flags)

ctags.name: migrate_paths
ctags.signature: (struct tmp_objdir * t,struct strbuf * src,struct strbuf * dst,enum finalize_object_file_flags flags)

ctags.name: tmp_objdir_reapply_primary_odb
ctags.signature: (struct tmp_objdir * t,const char * old_cwd,const char * new_cwd)
